question: 1. Display employee name, hire date, current date, and days worked.
query: SELECT ENAME, HIREDATE, SYSDATE, ROUND(SYSDATE - HIREDATE) AS DAYS_WORKED FROM EMP;

question: 2. Display employee name and hire date in format: Monday, January 01, 2024.
query: SELECT ENAME, TO_CHAR(HIREDATE, 'Day, Month DD, YYYY') AS FORMATTED_DATE FROM EMP;

question: 3. Find employees who joined in the same month as the current system date.
query: SELECT * FROM EMP WHERE TO_CHAR(HIREDATE, 'MM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM');

question: 4. Display employee name and the next Monday after their hire date.
query: SELECT ENAME, NEXT_DAY(HIREDATE, 'MONDAY') AS NEXT_MON FROM EMP;

question: 5. Display employee name and the last day of their joining month.
query: SELECT ENAME, LAST_DAY(HIREDATE) AS END_MONTH FROM EMP;

question: 6. Find employees who have completed more than 10 years in the company.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, HIREDATE) / 12 > 10;

question: 7. Display employee name and number of months worked.
query: SELECT ENAME, ROUND(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, HIREDATE)) AS MONTHS FROM EMP;

question: 8. Display hire date after adding 3 years and 6 months.
query: SELECT ENAME, ADD_MONTHS(HIREDATE, 42) AS FUTURE_DATE FROM EMP;

question: 9. Find employees hired between two given dates (using TO_DATE).
query: SELECT * FROM EMP WHERE HIREDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('01-JAN-81','DD-MON-YY') AND TO_DATE('31-DEC-81','DD-MON-YY');

question: 10. Display the difference in years between SYSDATE and hire date (rounded).
query: SELECT ENAME, ROUND(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, HIREDATE)/12) AS YEARS FROM EMP;

question: 11. Display salary rounded to the nearest 1000.
query: SELECT ENAME, ROUND(SAL, -3) AS ROUND_SAL FROM EMP;

question: 12. Display salary truncated to 2 decimal places.
13. Display employee name and square root of salary.
14. Find the absolute difference between salary and 5000.
query: SELECT ENAME, ABS(SAL - 5000) AS DIFF FROM EMP;

16. Display salary rounded down (FLOOR).

18. Display remainder when salary is divided by 2000.
19. Display salary raised to the power of 3.
20. Round salary to nearest hundred and thousand.
